data.title: 夜莺 · 晨曦微风中赤足轻踏微波的自由呼吸
data.action: 缓步涉入退潮后平缓的金色水镜浅滩中，双手轻轻提着长泳裙下摆防湿，闭上双眸感受迎面海风
data.location: 晨曦笼罩下的广袤无人细沙镜面浅海滩
data.lighting: 初升红日的万道金光穿透晨雾，在广阔平静的海滩水膜上打出长长的金色倒影，如梦似幻
data.mood: 重获自由的圣洁释怀、宁静感动与梦醒般的平静
data.description: 鸟笼的阴影终于被无垠的大海融化。丽兹赤足踩在如镜面般平整的浅滩水波中，纯白蕾丝裙摆随风摇曳，仿佛随时会化作羽翼飞去。她微微仰起柔美的脸庞，任由温热的第一缕阳光抚摸眼睑，嘴角泛起久违的恬静弧度——「大海的尽头……原来没有锁链。海风是暖的，没有药水的气味。闪灵说得对……世界真的很广阔。」
data.promptProse: Nightingale wades barefoot across a mirror-flat shallow tide at sunrise, wearing a pure white embossed floral-lace empire-waist swimdress with a drifting sheer mint-green chiffon shawl. Holding her hem lightly above the ripples with her eyes closed in serene relief, she glows in warm golden sunrise rays reflecting across the tranquil beach.
data.animaCaption: Wading barefoot across mirror-still sunrise shallows in a white floral-lace swimdress and drifting mint-green sheer shawl, she lifts her hem delicately and closes her eyes to the warm sea breeze. Golden dawn light reflects seamlessly across the wet sand around her feet.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white embossed floral-lace empire-waist swimdress paired with a floating sheer mint-green chiffon shoulder shawl.
